hero.description: Mifos X is designed by the <mifosLink>Mifos Initiative</mifosLink>. A <communityLink>global community</communityLink> that aims to speed the elimination of poverty by enabling Organizations to more effectively and efficiently deliver responsible financial services to the world's poor and unbanked.
